name: rad-mcp
description: General Radiance lighting simulation as a local MCP server: project and geometry import (OBJ, .rad) with octree checks, materials with provenance, sensor grids to EN 12464-1/EN 17037/LM-83, weather (EPW), BSDF inspection and genBSDF, window groups, point-in-time illuminance and daylight factor, annual 2/3/5-phase simulation with LM-83 blinds, sDA/ASE/UDI and EN 17037 compliance, rpict renders and falsecolor, evalglare DGP, IES luminaires with UGR and EN 12464-1 uniformity, view out and sunlight exposure, and reproducible script export. Ships two skills: the Radiance CLI workflow and the lighting standards requirements.
